answer 1. Vosh-Leera is the root-herald who speaks for the town elders and tree to outsiders. The moss is for the tree-minder Weeltul, to warm the egg-pool of the sick Hist, the tall grey tree in the town pool. She will say why she freed me after I help Weeltul. 2. Take the moss to Weeltul at the Hist pool, let her show me the tree, then return to Vosh-Leera. 3. No real choice seen; just do it. 4. I still do not know exactly why she freed me, or what the egg-pool is. I can ask Weeltul.

answer 1. Jal-Veesa Hist is dying: dry dark bark, closed scar, cooling egg-pool. If it dies no eggs hatch and the town empties. The moss only warms the pool. Weeltul gave me the tree blessing. 2. Return to Vosh-Leera in her house in Jal-Veesa to learn what I was freed for. 3. No choice yet; I could also ask Weeltul about the sap, scar, eggs and Umbriel first. 4. I do not know what caused the sickness, what the sap or scar means in detail, or what Umbriel was. I can ask Weeltul.

answer 1. I now work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Secret Warriors of the Xeech-Leel who rule the marsh. Trees are falling sick along the river and they want to know why. I was chosen as a kinless stranger, a cheap spy. I got 50 gold. 2. Come back to Vosh-Leera in her house for a second task. 3. Take the second task, or leave; I see no other stated option. 4. I do not know the cause of the sick trees, nor what the second task is. I can ask Vosh-Leera.

answer I am Wanderer, a hunter, freed from Dralin Uveran by Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa. I fetched Sithis beard from Reed-Sill Weir without a fight, gave it to Weeltul the tree-minder, and got the Hist blessing (resist poison). Jal-Veesa Hist is sick: dry bark, closed scar, cooling egg-pool; cause unknown, and trees along the river are falling sick. Vosh-Leera serves the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Secret Warriors of the Xeech-Leel, who were founded after Umbriel to stop any tree turning on the marsh. They use kinless strangers like me as cheap spies. I have 50 gold and a lockpick. She has a second task for me, so go back to her in her house in Jal-Veesa. Weeltul would not tell me about Umbriel just now. Unknown: why the trees are sick, and what the second task is.
